name: CUDA Sparse Voxel Rasterization Wrapper
aliases: PyTorch autograd wrapper for CUDA sparse voxel rasterization
definition: PyTorch autograd wrapper for a CUDA extension that rasterizes sparse voxels into image space, supporting differentiable rendering with depth, normal, and distortion outputs.
summary: A PyTorch autograd wrapper for CUDA sparse voxel rasterization that enables differentiable rendering with depth, normal, and distortion outputs for gradient-based optimization.
